fields.System.Title: OUT-701 — Maintain the order status view
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a customer service agent, I want order status answered from one row, so that the
query stays fast as order history grows.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given any order event — received, allocated, picked, packed, shipped, cancelled — then
  • the order_status row is updated from that event.
  • - Given the projection, then it holds state, lines picked, lines total, carrier,
  • tracking, and last_updated_at.
  • - Given the update, then it happens asynchronously so dispatch is not slowed.
  • - Given a rebuild job, then it exists and is delivered with this story.
  • - Given a rebuild on correct data, then every row is unchanged.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound |
| Tables | order_status projection |
| Risks | Projection drift ([doc 08 §10](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)); no rebuild job ([doc 08 §3](../../../docs/08-data-sync-and-migrations.md)) |
| Tests | integration · rebuild-vs-incremental agreement |
